hero.title: Scenic River Cruises Review
hero.subtitle: Honest Review of Ships, Suites, Dining, Inclusions & Value
description: Scenic River Cruises is one of the most luxurious all-inclusive river cruise lines in Europe and Southeast Asia. Travelers consistently choose Scenic for its spacious suites, butler service, premium dining, included excursions, and worry-free pricing.
If you want a luxury vacation where nearly everything is included and exceptional service is a priority, Scenic is one of the strongest options available. Overall Rating: ★★★★★ (4.8/5)
hero.moreText: If you want a luxury vacation where nearly everything is included and exceptional service is a priority, Scenic is one of the strongest options available.

whatMakesDifferent.title: What Makes Scenic Different?
whatMakesDifferent.subtitle: Almost Everything Is Included in Your Cruise Fare
paragraphs: Many luxury river cruise lines offer premium experiences, but Scenic's biggest advantage is that almost everything is included in the cruise fare.

Instead of paying extra throughout your vacation, Scenic includes many services that other cruise lines charge separately for. This creates a stress-free luxury vacation with very few surprise expenses.

Unlimited premium beverages & fine wines
All onboard & onshore gratuities included
Complimentary airport transfers
Scenic Freechoice excursions in every port
Scenic Enrich exclusive private events
Specialty gourmet dining venues
Complimentary Wi-Fi throughout the ship

faqs.question: Is Scenic River Cruises truly all-inclusive?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic includes premium beverages, butler service, gratuities, Wi-Fi, airport transfers, Scenic Freechoice excursions, and Scenic Enrich experiences on most itineraries.

faqs.question: Is Scenic worth the money?
faqs.answer: For travelers seeking a premium all-inclusive experience, many guests feel Scenic offers excellent value because so many luxury amenities are included.

faqs.question: What is the average age on Scenic River Cruises?
faqs.answer: Most guests are typically 55 and older, although Scenic also attracts younger couples celebrating anniversaries, milestone birthdays, and retirement trips.

faqs.question: Is Scenic good for first-time river cruisers?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. Scenic's all-inclusive approach makes it one of the easiest luxury river cruise lines for first-time travelers.

faqs.question: Are drinks included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Premium wines, beer, spirits, soft drinks, coffee, and tea are generally included throughout the cruise.

faqs.question: Is butler service included?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every suite includes personalized butler service.

faqs.question: Does Scenic include excursions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic Freechoice excursions and Scenic Enrich experiences are included on most itineraries.

faqs.question: How does Scenic compare with Riverside?
faqs.answer: Scenic emphasizes an all-inclusive luxury experience with butler service and extensive inclusions, while Riverside focuses on boutique luxury, larger suites, and a quieter onboard atmosphere.

faqs.question: Should I book Scenic through a travel advisor?
faqs.answer: Yes. A luxury travel advisor can compare itineraries, explain promotions, recommend the best suite category, and help coordinate every aspect of your vacation.

faqs.question: What is the dress code onboard Scenic river cruises?
faqs.answer: The onboard dress code is casual and comfortable during the day, and smart casual in the evenings. There are no formal nights, so formal wear like suits and evening gowns are not required.

faqs.question: Are laundry services available on Scenic ships?
faqs.answer: Yes. Scenic offers onboard laundry services. Depending on your suite category, complimentary laundry service (ranging from a limited number of items to unlimited daily laundry) is provided by your butler.
